feature_contract.goal: Keep the entire original +TIME stage-extension HUD visible in the intended binocular eye route when its sprite and numeric glyph nodes are the first producers appended to an empty real-game SpriteQueue priority chain; reject stale tail provenance without changing the ordinary timer or GOAL behavior.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: This feature repairs root-sentinel tail provenance for exact +TIME sprite and numeric glyph batches only; it does not alter GOAL timing, generic gameplay HUD, lens discs, world stereo, SkyGlow, FFB/input, R26_SAFE, DX11, or the frozen DXVK backend.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: The native game empty priority-list uses the root sentinel as tail_4. The pre-fix FirstVerifiedAppendedNode treated any non-null old tail as a real node, returning null when +TIME first populated that list; later queued siblings were incorrectly privileged over the first exact source.
trace_stages: Original executable +TIME sprite producers at 0x9898E/0x98A36/0x98AC6 and numeric print at 0x989AD/0x98A10/0x98A89 enter the exact stage extension semantic owner.

The original SpriteQueue priority root initially points tail_4 at itself; FirstVerifiedAppendedNode now walks the live bounded root-next chain to prove new tail identity and recover the first exact append, preserving sprite and glyph producer identity through deferred queue submission.

R84 stage extension physical HUD Draw consumes source-confirmed SpriteNodes for bilateral eye-plane rendering; unsafe stale, truncated, detached, and sentinel-as-data tails fail closed to original game rendering and the existing x64 OpenXR composition remains unchanged.
subcomponents: Prove the game priority-list empty tail root sentinel as a valid before-tail rather than a detached live sprite.
Retain both first queued stage sprite and numeric glyph nodes while rejecting stale, truncated and disconnected queue-chain cases.
Compile and execute the host source-level positive/negative tail regression with direct header dependency, preserving R84 eye dispatch and native fallbacks.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Native SpriteQueue tail_4 starts at the root itself for an empty priority queue; +TIME can be the first exact source to append sprites and numeric glyphs to that list in a frame.
source_trace: Game UI producer StageExtensionSpraniCalls/StageExtensionPrintCalls emits stage +TIME sprite and numeric glyph identities via the original stage source hooks.
src/vr/game/sprite_queue_tail_proof.hpp FirstVerifiedAppendedNode observes root, old tail, new tail and bounded live next_0 chain at deferred sprite queue handoff.
R84 stereo stage HUD consumer receives only proven SpriteNode source tags and keeps original rendering when proof fails before OpenXR host composition.
diagnosis.root_cause: The first exact stage +TIME priority-list producer was silently missed because the prior code assumed every non-null oldTail was an existing data node, ignoring the empty-list root-as-tail sentinel.
alternatives_rejected: Do not flush all delayed D3DX batches, force a stereo promotion without queue proof, alter game timer/GOAL logic, or disable unrelated SkyGlow and lens effects.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material source commit 1925d36ba763243df0dc218a9bbabf5d545872a2 makes root sentinel handling explicit and refuses root as a new data tail. Follow-up 8f1c3c23b18b496f9256aa83cde28ab20d0aca87 adds the missing test include for the actual helper.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: vrhost/tests/stage_extension_direct_owner_smoke.cpp returns distinct failures for bounded traversal shorter than new tail, stale new tail, sentinel-as-data, and detached old tail; also verifies both empty-root and ordinary nonempty priority append.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The existing source-owned stage HUD is eligible for R84 binocular routing only with proven physical SpriteNode identity; otherwise preserve the native draw, not a cached world WVP. Same-SHA Quest3/VDXR stereo observation has not been performed.
